sections.heading: A new threat to the top seven
sections.text: artificialagencylab.com moved from 14th to eighth in a recorded overnight score event, lifting its mark from 38.62 to 41.74. That puts it just 0.23 behind seventh-place Son & Mark & Ronen. The advance pushes ARC Slayers to ninth and Vineeth Sai Varikuntla to tenth, with neither losing score since the midnight comparison. The new top-ten order is a consequence of a challenger improving, rather than the incumbents retreating.

sections.heading: The lab behind the name
sections.text: The fresh roster lists cmechevalier and richardcsaky. Artificial Agency Lab’s own site identifies Richard Csaky and Côme Chevalier and links its dated ARC work. Its historical research describes structured grid and image observations, persistent context updates and fixed model weights. That is useful background on the contender, but it does not establish the method behind this morning’s improvement. The recorded move is clear; its current submission recipe remains unverified.

sections.heading: Tufa and Chen keep their separation
sections.text: Tufa Labs remains first at 68.91, ahead of Yi-Chia Chen’s 67.49 by 1.42 points. Neither score changed across the midnight comparison. Dries Smit remains among Tufa’s listed accounts; Chen’s listed handle is threerabbits. Below them, mtg holds third at 45, NVARC3 fourth at 43.94 and the last dance fifth at 43.64. NVARC3’s current roster lists six accounts; its team result should not be attributed to any one member.

sections.heading: The last gold place gets dearer
sections.text: mikelou1’s recorded rise from 35.42 to 37.27 carried it from 32nd to 17th overnight. The 18th-place public gold line now stands at 37.18, up from 37.12 in the midnight baseline. Tom. occupies that final position. The earlier wire had already reported _hans and Lord Han Solo slipping outside gold without losing score; this morning they stand 20th and 21st. These are provisional public positions, with private evaluation still to come.

sections.heading: Deep climbs, and a separate model result
sections.text: rutilo’s overnight event took its score from 28.81 to 33.57 and its observed rank from 696th to 52nd. The wire’s companion report on Benedicte HELFER drew on an October 13 event, so that earlier climb is not another morning gain. Fresh later events also put Saket Poswal at 33.94 and Harsh Patel at 33.87, reaching the top fifty at their observations. Beyond the Kaggle race, ARC Prize’s October 13 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash report remains consequential context: its linked verified table shows about three percent with the provider adapter and below one percent with the standard harness. The headline best configurations use different reasoning settings. This is an organizer model evaluation, separate from team submissions.
